How It Works

The simplest way to walk someone through what the system does.

1

Patient fills the intake form

Before the consultation, the patient answers a short, guided set of questions about their symptoms and history — on their phone or a kiosk in the waiting area.

2

The system organizes it

Answers are sorted into the sections a doctor actually needs, and any red flag symptoms are automatically flagged for attention.

3

Doctor sees a ready summary

Instead of a blank form, the doctor opens a clean, structured summary the moment the patient sits down — no re-asking what's already been said.

4

The record stays with the patient

Next visit, at any department, the same history is already there — searchable, and ready to build on instead of starting over.
